buildings.masonry_and_palette: Warm red brick/terracotta; dark slate roofs; oxidized green finials/crosses
buildings.observed_features: Wide E10 Gothic frontage with tall pointed-arch windows in three main tiers. Left portion has two roof dormers with steep triangular gables. Taller center/right block has a prominent gabled dormer with paired open arches and a pierced/circular upper detail. At Avenue A corner, a narrow square bell tower rises above all other masses: paired open lancet belfry openings and very steep four-sided slate spire/pyramidal roof topped by cross/finial. Avenue A return contains a lower steep-gabled church-hall/nave face with very tall central lancet grouping. Facade lower level sits behind black iron railing. Decorative terracotta frieze/lion panel on E10 wall.
